description: Lioromic wears a charcoal-brown knee-length wool tunic or cote with narrow gold scrolling embroidery along the central opening, hem and cuffs. A cream linen shirt shows at his open collar and wrists. A broad decorated brown leather belt with circular metal ornaments and a long hanging strap sits at the waist. A burgundy shoulder mantle with a woven gold border crosses the chest and fastens with a round brooch on his right shoulder. Brown fitted trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the outfit. There is no headgear, armor, weapon or crown.
